entries.note: Resolve existing ancestors as real paths before checking each output against the consumer root, including per-file symlinks in a preexisting profile. Installation rejects differing files before writing and uses exclusive creation with a second comparison for races. This is a local convenience installer, not an OS access boundary against a concurrent adversary swapping directories. The home launcher records explicit project/profile/runtime/checkout paths and the installation PATH, quotes every static shell argument, and leaves agent launch opt-in. The profile has no workspace-global registry or consumer-repository edits. The declaration is read by `red-project declaration` from a throwaway directory before any output is written, so a declaration this installer would not be able to open leaves the profile, the launcher and the consumer untouched.
